stories.title: Third storm heads for already drenched B.C. coast
stories.summary: The third in a series of storms is heading for B.C., after wild weather knocked out power to thousands, triggered evacuations and left one person dead over the weekend.

stories.title: B.C. lab ordered to pay $32K for misgendering transgender, non-binary patients
stories.summary: British Columbia's human rights tribunal found LifeLabs and its subsidiary Excelleris Technologies misgendered and outed three patients at clinics in Vancouver and Burnaby in 2019.

stories.title: Mom says B.C. soldier who died at CFB Wainwright was her ‘bright light’
stories.summary: Goulding had been participating in live-fire exercises at CFB Wainwright last month as part of training for potential deployment overseas.

stories.title: 1 dead after tree falls on 2 vehicles during second B.C. storm
stories.summary: A number of storms have hit British Columbia this weekend leaving thousands without power after trees were downed by strong winds, with more wind gusts expected.

stories.title: Draisaitl powers Oilers past Canucks
stories.summary: Leon Draisaitl had two goals and an assist and Connor McDavid added three assists as the Edmonton Oilers came away with a 4-2 victory over the struggling Vancouver Canucks on Saturday.

stories.title: Captured bear undergoes DNA testing to determine involvement in deadly attack
stories.summary: The BC Conservation Officer Service said any bears involved in the attack will be killed to protect public safety. Unrelated bears will be released.

stories.title: First of season storms bring ‘minor’ flooding, outages to B.C.
stories.summary: As storms continue across B.C., authorities are warning about high winds bringing more power outages and the dangers of rising water levels.

stories.title: One of Okanagan’s most colourful characters dies at 96
stories.summary: Eddy Haymour died Wednesday at the age of 96, leaving behind a remarkable story of ambition, controversy and a dream that never quite came to fruition.

stories.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions Canadian firms connected to Ryan Wedding and Iran
stories.summary: The department says it sanctioned money services businesses in British Columbia and Ontario in co-ordination with Fintrac, Canada's anti-money laundering watchdog.
